subject.title: i18n(zh-TW): align Control UI locale with Taiwan-standard terminology

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this Taiwan-standard terminology set for the zh-TW Control UI once the branch is rebased and regenerated against current main?
rationale: The code shape and runtime proof are sound, but idiomatic regional terminology and contextual word choices cannot be safely approved through automated source review alone.

options.title: Approve and refresh
options.body: Accept the terminology direction and request a rebase plus fresh i18n synchronization and focused validation before merge.

options.title: Request wording revisions
options.body: Keep the PR open while a zh-TW reviewer identifies specific terms or contexts that should change before regeneration.

options.title: Decline the terminology pass
options.body: Close the PR only if maintainers intentionally prefer the current vocabulary or a different locale strategy.

recommendation.title: Approve and refresh
recommendation.body: Accept the terminology direction and request a rebase plus fresh i18n synchronization and focused validation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository policy directly identifies this person as the translation-pipeline contact, and the decision spans generated locale, TM, and glossary ownership.
